# Anno Domini

> Anno Domini is a fractional AI partner that builds custom AI operating systems inside UK small and medium businesses — installing infrastructure that returns time and decision-making to the people doing the work, then handing it over for the client to own.

Anno Domini builds bespoke internal tooling and workflow automation (not subscription software or generic automation platforms). Engagements run as a repeatable cycle — brief, build, deliver, repeat — with each delivery small, documented, and owned by the client. Every tool was first built and run inside a live operation before any external client was taken on.

## Main page
- [Anno Domini — A Fractional AI Partner](https://annodom.com/): what Anno Domini does, who it is for, how engagements work, and proof of systems already running. Covers:
  - **Approach / How it works** — the brief → build → deliver → repeat cycle; working solutions shipped in 3–7 days, with a walkthrough and documentation the client owns.
  - **What we build** — a custom AI operating system installed inside the business (CV screening, client updates, report generation, CRM integration, pipeline views, query handling).
  - **The problem** — manual hours lost to lead screening, client chasing, and unfinished pipeline spreadsheets.
  - **Ways to work together** — Session, Audit, Project, Retainer.
  - **Proof** — email lead generation, newsletter infrastructure, and pipeline reporting already deployed and in daily use.
